photos.c: Our picture shows four of the club's elder statesmen in a relaxed mood during this year's Centenary Club '20' road race. ... They are (left to right) :- Ken O'Kell (86) - 64 years a member, Bill Webb (93) - 60 years a member, Frank Webb (84) - 59 years a member, Norman Dewberry (85) - 59 years a member

Bill Webb has got an "ology" - Campanology - as he inaugurates the "Centenary Bell" which bears the inscription: "This bell was unveiled by the most Senior past President - W.G.Webb - on the 100th Birthday of the Club 7 October 1987". The Bell was donated by Chas.Manning Past President.
